summary: Frontend-only re-verification (iter 255) of the terminology bug on a fresh agency tenant (terminology_v6@kora.com, industry=agency, modules: program_orchestration + demand_studio + module_resource_management, 3 projects promoted to Committed) in Spanish. (a) Dashboard FIXED: with a HARD RELOAD of /dashboard, System Pulse > 'Decisiones Recientes' renders 'Proyecto confirmado' x3 and zero 'Evento confirmado' from the first render; Dashboard.js:189 deps confirmed as [isEs, entitySingular, entityPlural]. (b) EventPackingSection standalone view (/ops-supplies/event-packing) verified ON SCREEN for the first time: Label = 'Proyecto' (FIXED), select placeholder = 'Selecciona un proyecto' (FIXED), options list all 3 projects, Apply-Template dialog strings already terminology-ized in code (line 583/587). REMAINING: CardTitle still renders the hardcoded 'Packing List por Evento' (only 'Evento' token left on the whole page) and the select empty-state literal 'No hay eventos confirmados' is still hardcoded (line 307, not renderable with 3 confirmed projects but verified in code). Tenant deleted at the end.

minor.issue: modules_to_activate accepts the legacy key 'module_operations_supplies' and echoes it in activated_modules, but /api/addons/enabled-modules matches on MODULE_ADDONS keys ('module_resource_management'). MODULE_ALIASES exists but is not applied, so the module is silently NOT enabled and /ops-supplies redirects to /dashboard. Had to recreate the tenant with 'module_resource_management' to reach the page.

ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED. CardTitle is still the hardcoded literal t("Packing List por Evento", "Packing List by Event"). Rendered on screen at /ops-supplies/event-packing for the agency tenant while the Label right below it correctly says 'Proyecto'. Should use term("events","entity_singular") like lines 295/302.

NOT FIXED. Select empty-state literal t("No hay eventos confirmados", "No confirmed events") is still hardcoded; must be terminology-ized ('No hay proyectos confirmados'). Verified by code inspection (cannot render with 3 confirmed projects seeded).
